# All blobs extracted from a Lenovo K8 (brady, MT6757) Android 7.1.1 (32-bit) stock dump.
# Generated by static filename analysis, then reconciled against a real
# proprietary-files.txt from the Infinix X603 (same MT6757 platform, 32+64-bit).
# Reconciliation changes:
#   - paths made relative to /system (no "system/" prefix); vendor/ and oem/
#     keep their partition prefix, matching the reference's convention.
#   - all lib64/ entries dropped -- brady is a 32-bit-only ROM, no 64-bit
#     libraries exist in the dump to begin with.
#   - boot/recovery ramdisk binaries (fuelgauged_static, multi_init) removed;
#     those belong in the kernel/device-tree ramdisk overlay, not here --
#     confirmed by the reference containing no ramdisk paths at all.
#   - several files that look like stock AOSP (bin/vold, bin/wpa_supplicant,
#     bin/gatekeeperd, most etc/permissions/android.hardware.*.xml,
#     etc/init/mediaserver.rc and friends, wifi/bluetooth confs, media_codecs
#     xmls) turned out to be shipped as prebuilt blobs on this MT6757 platform
#     in the reference tree, so they were added back in rather than assumed
#     AOSP-buildable.
# This is still filename-based, not hash-diffed against a built LineageOS
# 14.1 tree -- that remains the reliable way to confirm each entry.
#
# Third pass: pruned system/lib, vendor/bin, vendor/etc, vendor/data,
# vendor/plugin, vendor/res, and vendor/thh down to what a normal LOS 14.1
# daily-driver build needs. Kept anything tied to: firmware loading, thermal
# and power-management safety, sensors (kept ALL magnetometer/accel daemon
# variants -- akmd/ami304d/bmm050d/lsm303md/mc6420d/memsicd*/qmcX983d --
# since a stock ROM ships drivers for every BOM sensor option and a filename
# list can't tell you which chip is actually populated on this unit), the
# audio pipeline, the camera pipeline, radio/IMS/WiFi-calling (this pulled
# the full IPsec/strongSwan stack back in -- ePDG/WFC tunnels to the
# carrier over IKEv2/IPsec, it is not a general-purpose VPN client here),
# and GPS/AGPS. Dropped factory test tools, modem/system diagnostic
# loggers, MTK's AEE crash-archival chain (kept the "aee" daemon itself,
# dropped the archive/forwarder/dumpstate/mrdump utilities around it),
# RenderScript shader-cache services, Google hotword training data, and a
# Tencent Soter mobile-payment fingerprint add-on (vendor/thh) that is
# unrelated to the actual fingerprint HAL already kept elsewhere.
#
# vendor/lib (~280 files) and vendor/firmware were NOT hand-pruned. Past
# this point, filenames stop being a reliable signal: most of what's left
# is either a firmware blob for a specific low-power/DRAM state (removing
# the wrong one is a silent hang, not an error you'd see in logcat) or a
# dependency dlopen'd by the camera/audio/RIL HALs already kept, where a
# plausible-looking name doesn't tell you which binary calls it. Pruning
# further here trades an unverifiable guess for a real chance of breaking
# camera, audio, or radio -- that's a worse trade than carrying ~15MB of
# maybe-unused libraries. If you want to go further, the correct method is
# strings/objdump on the HAL blobs you're keeping to see what they actually
# dlopen, not more filename guessing.

# ==========================================================================
# system/app -- almost everything here is Lenovo/Motorola bloat with no
# hardware dependency, so it's cut. Kept only GFManager, because it is the
# userspace client for the Goodix fingerprint HAL (goodixfingerprintd,
# libgf_algo.so, libgf_ca.so, libgf_hal.so, all already listed under lib/)
# -- dropping it would likely leave the fingerprint sensor non-functional
# even though the HAL libraries are present.
# ==========================================================================
app/GFManager/GFManager.apk

# Explicitly dropped (system/app), all safe to omit -- LineageOS provides
# its own equivalents or the feature is cosmetic/carrier/telemetry bloat:
#   3c_main                        Lenovo device-management telemetry
#   FaceLock                       legacy face-unlock, optional feature only
#   MotGeoFenceSvc                 Moto geofencing service
#   MotoDemoModeFWProxy            retail demo mode
#   MotoSignatureApp               Moto app-signature verification
#   SimLock                        carrier SIM-lock enforcement
#   TimeWeather                    Moto weather widget
#   com.motorola.android.nativedropboxagent   Moto crash-report agent

# ==========================================================================
# system/priv-app -- same story: kept only entries with no LineageOS
# equivalent and no clean way to reconstruct their function; everything
# else is Lenovo/Motorola UI chrome, carrier provisioning, telemetry, or a
# provider that stock Settings/other stock apps reference but LOS's own
# replacements never call.
# ==========================================================================
# (nothing kept from this directory -- see the drop list below)

# Explicitly dropped (system/priv-app):
#   3c_checkin, 3c_devicemanagement, 3c_notification, 3c_ota   Lenovo MDM/telemetry stack
#   AppDirectedSmsProxy            carrier-directed SMS routing
#   AutoPackageInstaller           Lenovo OOBE app installer
#   CharacterCallSetting           carrier call-feature UI
#   ChromeHomePageProvider         browser homepage bloat
#   CoreSettingsExt                content provider for stock Settings only
#   CQATest                        factory QA test app
#   DemoMode                       retail demo mode
#   DMService                      OMA-DM carrier device management
#   EasyPrefix                     dialing-prefix helper
#   InvisibleNet                   captive-portal bypass utility
#   LenovoBlackGestures            screen-off gesture UI (cosmetic feature loss)
#   LenovoBreathingLight           notification LED effect (cosmetic feature loss)
#   LenovoId                       Lenovo cloud account service
#   LenovoVRMode                   VR mode toggle
#   LMIRescueSecurity (+ liblmirescue_v19.so)   Lenovo anti-theft/security suite
#   ModemStatsService              modem statistics collector
#   MotCamera (+ libjni_mot_mosaic.so)   stock camera app, superseded by LOS camera
#   MotoCare, MotoCareInt          Motorola customer-care app
#   MotoHide                       app-hiding utility (depends on the oem/ hide overlay, dropped too)
#   MotoOneTimeInitializer         Moto first-boot initializer
#   MotorolaSettingsProvider       content provider for stock Settings only
#   MSimSettings                   dual-SIM settings UI, LOS Settings has its own
#   MusicKey                       hardware media-key intent handler
#   OMAProvisioning                carrier OTA provisioning
#   OpenMtkLogger                  MTK logging UI (bin/vendor logging tools still present)
#   ProxyHandler                   duplicate of AOSP's own PacProcessor
#   RecoveryDemo                   recovery demo mode
#   SEPolicyUpdate                 stock sepolicy updater; LOS ships its own sepolicy
#   SingleHand                     one-handed mode UI (cosmetic feature loss)
#   StorageOptimizer               Lenovo storage-cleanup UI
#   WpaConfigApp                   Wi-Fi config UI, duplicate of stock Settings
# CarrierConfig/CarrierServices/CarrierSettingsExt/CellBroadcastReceiver are
# GMS-signed and normally ship via a separate GApps package, not the device
# tree. Uncomment only if your target has no GApps addon:
#priv-app/CarrierConfig/CarrierConfig.apk
#priv-app/CarrierServices/CarrierServices.apk
#priv-app/CarrierSettingsExt/CarrierSettingsExt.apk

# ==========================================================================
# oem partition -- entirely bloat/demo content once MotoHide is dropped
# (the hide overlay/resources exist only to support it). Preloaded MS
# Office trial stubs and the Lenovo app-store OOBE installer have zero
# bearing on whether the device boots or functions. Dropping the whole
# partition's proprietary content:
# ==========================================================================
# Explicitly dropped (oem/):
#   etc/motorola/hide/*.xml                    feature-hiding rules for MotoHide (dropped)
#   etc/oem_sign_info, oem.prop                 OEM signing/branding metadata, not needed
#   overlay/framework-res-oem, Motohide-res      resource overlays for MotoHide (dropped)
#   priv-app/AppCloudOobeLenovoOEM               Lenovo app-store OOBE installer
#   priv-app/msft_Excel, msft_Onenote_stub,
#     msft_Outlook_Stub, msft_PowerPoint,
#     msft_Skype_stub, msft_Word                 preloaded MS Office/Skype trial stubs

# ==========================================================================
# system/etc -- MediaTek hardware configs kept; Motorola app-wiring dropped.
# The etc/motorola/perms, etc/nondisable, etc/permissions/com.motorola.*,
# etc/sysconfig/com.motorola.*, and etc/updatecmds/com.motorola.* files
# below all exist to grant permissions to, exempt from being disabled, or
# carry OTA update commands for priv-apps/apps that were removed above (or
# were never in this build at all, e.g. LauncherConfig/SetupWizardExt/
# PreloadContacts, which are Google-signed and come from GApps if used).
# Keeping them with no corresponding app installed is dead weight, not risk,
# but there's no reason to carry them forward either.
# ==========================================================================
